_comment: Settings passed with --settings to every unattended `claude -p` phase run in GitHub Actions (build guide step 30; article p.40: containers under a network policy, short-lived scoped tokens, no production credentials). Bare mode (API-key path) reads no settings by itself, so this file is always passed explicitly. It mirrors template/.claude/settings.json (decision 6 layer iii: hooks and permissions come from the pinned framework, never from the PR branch) with the differences a runner allows: the sandbox is mandatory (failIfUnavailable true; the job installs bubblewrap and socat first), the allowed domains are the API, GitHub and the package registries, and the allow-list covers the framework's own scripts so the run never waits on a prompt (--permission-prompts none denies anything else). The four Edit deny rules are spelled with a leading slash, the project-root anchor of a project settings file; because a /path rule in a --settings file anchors at that file's own directory, run_phase.ci_settings_file passes a temporary copy with them rewritten to //<absolute project root>/... (NOTES sections 6 and 12).
